name: Raspberry Pi controller
on:
  push:
    paths: ['RaspberryPi_Controller/**', 'ESP32_Dispenser_Controller/COMMANDS.md', 'ESP32_Modular_Command_Transport_Controller/COMMANDS.md', '.github/workflows/raspberry-pi.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['RaspberryPi_Controller/**', 'ESP32_Dispenser_Controller/COMMANDS.md', 'ESP32_Modular_Command_Transport_Controller/COMMANDS.md', '.github/workflows/raspberry-pi.yml']
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: RaspberryPi_Controller
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
      - run: node --check web/app.js
      - run: sh -n deploy/install.sh
